Partnerships

Partner With Think Positive Always

We collaborate with brands, organisations, and publishers who share our belief that encouragement and practical tools can help people live better lives.

Our audience

A community that values growth

Think Positive Always speaks to an international, primarily English-speaking audience, including readers across the United States. Our community is made up of adults of all genders who are interested in mindset, confidence, resilience, relationships, and intentional living.

They come to us for encouragement and practical perspective, which is why we only partner on messages we believe will be genuinely useful to them.

Audience figures will be published in our media kit as dated measurements with their source.

See the media kit

Campaign formats

Ways we can work together

Every collaboration is shaped around shared goals. These are some of the formats we can explore.

  • Sponsored content

    Thoughtful articles and posts that share your message in a way that genuinely serves our readers.

  • Brand storytelling

    Collaborative stories that connect your brand's purpose with themes of growth, resilience, and well-being.

  • Digital campaigns

    Multi-channel campaigns designed around a shared goal, from awareness to community engagement.

  • Newsletter sponsorships

    Placement in The Positive Reset, our daily email, once the newsletter has launched.

  • Resource partnerships

    Co-created guides, challenges, or tools that offer real value to people investing in their growth.

Brand alignment

Partnerships built on shared values

Our readers' trust comes first. We look for partners whose work fits naturally with what Think Positive Always stands for.

  • Products, services, or causes that support well-being, growth, learning, or positive change.
  • A commitment to honest claims and respectful, inclusive messaging.
  • Respect for our audience: no misleading offers, pressure tactics, or harmful products.
  • Willingness to clearly disclose sponsored and affiliate relationships.

Media kit

Our media kit is being prepared. It will include an overview of the brand, our content focus, audience information, and partnership formats. Until it is published, we are happy to share relevant details directly with prospective partners.

How to make an inquiry

  1. Introduce your brand or organisation and what you do.
  2. Describe the campaign or collaboration you have in mind.
  3. Share your goals, preferred timeline, and any key requirements.

We use these details only to reply to your inquiry and to manage a possible partnership. They are seen by our partnerships team, never sold or added to mailing lists. See our privacy policy for how long we keep them and how to ask us to delete them. Privacy policy
